LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_PlanDesc: Pick the run's stops on the world map, up to {MOST}: depots, open ground, and your own colonies, where it drives in at the map's edge. Where it stands now is its first stop. Right-click when done.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_StopsDesc: Set what it does at each stop (deliver its load, fetch a depot's goods, or only wait) and how long it waits there.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_StartGizmoDesc: Set off round its stops, again and again. With nobody aboard, its route kit drives it, as far as radio reach allows.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_StopGizmoDesc: Stop where it is. Its stops are kept for next time.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_RefuseFetchOnMap: At a colony, give it a loading list instead: your people load it while it waits.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_RefuseLoadOffMap: Only at one of your colonies, where people can load it.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_LoadExplain: While it waits here, your people load these into it, less what it already carries. It leaves once all of it is loaded, or when its waiting time is up.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_Loaded: {VEHICLE} is loaded at {PLACE} and sets off.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_LoadedPart: {VEHICLE}'s time at {PLACE} is up and it sets off with only part of its loading list.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_Started: {VEHICLE} sets off on its supply run of {COUNT} stops.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_WaitNoDriver: nobody aboard to drive, and no working route kit.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_WaitNoReach: with nobody aboard, it sets off only in radio reach of home.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_WaitCannotLeave: it could not find a way off the map.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_WaitOthers: other vehicles have joined its convoy; split them off to run it alone.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_LostHold: {VEHICLE} drove out of radio reach of home and holds where it is until reach comes back.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_LostCarryOn: {VEHICLE} drove out of radio reach of home and carries on to its next stop.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_LostTurnBack: {VEHICLE} drove out of radio reach of home and turns back to its last stop.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_LinkBack: {VEHICLE} is back in radio reach and drives on.
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_DoingCrewless: on a supply run with nobody aboard, to {PLACE}
LanguageData.PhobosSupplyRun_InspectPlanned: A supply run of {COUNT} stops is planned.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_SupplyRunRadio: Crewless supply runs need radio reach
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_SupplyRunRadioDesc: With the radio framework, a supply truck with nobody aboard is driven by radio. Choose how strict that is.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_SupplyRunRadioAllT: Every mile of the run must stay in radio reach of home, through relays: relays decide how far your supply net stretches.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_SupplyRunRadioStar: To set off, and at stops
It needs reach only to set off from each stop; between stops it drives itself.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_SupplyRunLostLink: A crewless supply truck out of reach
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_SupplyRunLostLinkD: What a supply truck with nobody aboard does when it drives out of radio reach of home.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_SupplyRunLostLinkH: It stops and waits until reach comes back, open to whatever finds it there.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_SupplyRunLostLinkC: It keeps to its leg and picks the link up again later.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_SupplyRunLostLinkT: It heads back to the stop it last left.
